paragraphs: He is mentioned at the beginning of Mishnah Shekalim, chapter 5, as the Temple official in charge of those with intestinal illnesses. The Gemara explains that the priests, walking barefoot on the courtyard floor, eating meat and drinking water, suffered intestinal illnesses; he was their physician.
